title: 米家石墨烯油汀取暖器 · MA3
description: 青萍室温 PI 温控效果与取暖器状态。PI 需求、设备开关和档位均不代表实测功率；原有设备属性由独立只读 exporter 采集。

panels.title: 选定时段 · 累计开启时长

targets.expr: clamp_max(sum_over_time((miio_heater_ma3_power_on{job="miio-heater-ma3"} and on(job, instance) (time() - miio_heater_ma3_property_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="miio-heater-ma3",property="power_on"} <= 30) and on(job, instance) (up{job="miio-heater-ma3"} == 1))[$__range:15s]) * 15, $__range_s)
targets.legendFormat: 选定时段 · 累计开启时长

panels.description: 以 15 秒步长累计最近 30 秒内成功读取的开关状态，仅在 exporter 抓取成功时计入。短暂间隔使用最后确认状态；超过 30 秒无成功读数则不计入，请结合数据覆盖率查看。开关变化及时间边界存在采样误差。

panels.title: 选定时段 · 估算耗电量（900W）

targets.expr: (clamp_max(sum_over_time((miio_heater_ma3_power_on{job="miio-heater-ma3"} and on(job, instance) (time() - miio_heater_ma3_property_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="miio-heater-ma3",property="power_on"} <= 30) and on(job, instance) (up{job="miio-heater-ma3"} == 1))[$__range:15s]) * 15, $__range_s)) / 3600 * 0.9
targets.legendFormat: 选定时段 · 估算耗电量（900W）

panels.description: 累计开启秒数 ÷ 3600 × 0.9 kW，单位 kWh（度）。使用最近 30 秒内成功读取的开关状态，修复历史采集过程中的假空缺。覆盖率不足 100% 时仅代表已观测部分，可能低估。按开启期间恒定 900W 估算，非实测电量，未考虑内部温控、档位变化及待机功耗。

panels.title: 选定时段 · 开关数据覆盖率

targets.expr: clamp_max(count_over_time((miio_heater_ma3_power_on{job="miio-heater-ma3"} and on(job, instance) (time() - miio_heater_ma3_property_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="miio-heater-ma3",property="power_on"} <= 30) and on(job, instance) (up{job="miio-heater-ma3"} == 1))[$__range:15s]) * 15 / $__range_s, 1) or on() vector(0)
targets.legendFormat: 选定时段 · 开关数据覆盖率

panels.description: 耗电估算使用的有效时间比例。低于 100% 表示仍有无法恢复的时段，耗电量可能低估；不会把未知状态当作关机。最近成功读取超过 30 秒或 exporter 抓取失败均视为缺失。

panels.title: PI 室温与目标区间

targets.expr: heater_pi_temperature_celsius{job="heater-pi-controller"} and on(job, instance) (heater_pi_sensor_valid{job="heater-pi-controller"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (time() - heater_pi_sensor_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="heater-pi-controller"} <= 60) and on(job, instance) (up{job="heater-pi-controller"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (time() - heater_pi_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="heater-pi-controller"} < 45)

heater_pi_setpoint_celsius{job="heater-pi-controller"} and on(job, instance) (up{job="heater-pi-controller"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (time() - heater_pi_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="heater-pi-controller"} < 45)

(heater_pi_setpoint_celsius{job="heater-pi-controller"} - heater_pi_tolerance_celsius{job="heater-pi-controller"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="heater-pi-controller"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (time() - heater_pi_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="heater-pi-controller"} < 45)

(heater_pi_setpoint_celsius{job="heater-pi-controller"} + heater_pi_tolerance_celsius{job="heater-pi-controller"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="heater-pi-controller"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (time() - heater_pi_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="heater-pi-controller"} < 45)

panels.description: 目标区间用于评估温控效果，并非不可越过的硬限制。无效或过期的青萍读数不绘制。

panels.title: PI 加热需求与实际开关

targets.expr: heater_pi_demand_ratio{job="heater-pi-controller"} and on(job, instance) (up{job="heater-pi-controller"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (time() - heater_pi_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="heater-pi-controller"} < 45)

heater_pi_power{job="heater-pi-controller"} and on(job, instance) (heater_pi_heater_up{job="heater-pi-controller"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (up{job="heater-pi-controller"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (time() - heater_pi_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="heater-pi-controller"} < 45)

panels.description: 需求是期望占空比；开关仅表示设备开启，不代表实测功率。自动切换至少间隔 15 分钟。

panels.title: PI 比例项与积分项

panels.description: 初始 Kp=0.25/°C，Ki=0.25/(°C·小时)。结合室温和开关曲线评估积分累积与过冲。
